domain: Not related to the m2c-pseudocode template beyond superficial n-gram shape: paints one 32-tile-wide VRAM tilemap row (0x06006000) with a computed tile id derived from a runtime counter, then paints a second, vertically mirrored row 13 tiles further down with the same tile id plus a 0x800 attribute bit set (a horizontal-flip or alternate-palette bit), guarded by a row-range check the first write doesn't need.
behavior: reads a runtime counter via double indirection through the fixed cell Data_03001ef8 (a pointer-to-pointer style global); returns immediately if the value is above 79 (unsigned)
tile id = (value & 7) + 0xf081; row = 13 - (value / 8, rounded toward -inf via the classic '(v>=0?v:v+7)>>3' idiom); fills all 32 halfwords of that VRAM row with the tile id

second pass: same division recomputed (redundant re-evaluation, matching this corpus's established double-read idiom), row = (value/8) + 13; if that row exceeds 20 (unsigned) the function returns without the second write; otherwise fills that row with tile id | 0x800

bounded_search.reason: First candidate used 'for (i=0;i<32;i++) dst[i]=tile;' fill loops, which compiled to a pointer-limit-compare loop (116 bytes, 78 wrong instructions) instead of reference's counter-compare loop. Rewriting both fills as an explicit 'i=0; do { i++; *dst=tile; dst++; } while (i != 32);' idiom (matching the counter-based loop shape used elsewhere in this corpus) brought candidate to the exact reference size (112/112 bytes) with the full control-flow shape now matching instruction-for-instruction.

remaining: Same size, same control flow, same field/offset math -- the residual 38 differing halfwords are essentially all register-number swaps. Creating the signed division carrier before the tile expression now retains the runtime value in the reference's r0 and removes two mismatches, while the candidate still keeps the tile id in r1 and uses only caller-saved registers. The reference keeps the tile id in r4 and the first VRAM base in r5, so it pushes {r5, lr}. This is an allocation-order gap rather than a source-shape or behavioral gap; further work needs evidence for the tile/base lifetimes, not broad structural mutation.
notes: The Data_03001ef8 double-indirection and the 0x06006000 VRAM tilemap base are read directly from the retained assembly; no cross-owner corroboration was available for this specific cell within this pass's time budget.
